entries.sql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2011'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT CustomerID FROM t WHERE total = (SELECT MAX(total) FROM t);
